speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider working with the Ministry of Education to share with school students the risks associated with buying health products, especially those sold online.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: It included an animated YouTube video to explain the risks, and pop-up advisories targeted at consumers looking for health products online.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
text: There are also efforts targeted specifically at school students.
